newsitem.title: CHILE: Coca Cola in talks to buy Chilean bottler, report says.
newsitem.headline: Coca Cola in talks to buy Chilean bottler, report says.

text.p: A group of investors that includes The Coca Cola Co. is in talks to buy 5 percent of Chilean bottler Embotelladora Andina for about $100 million, the El Diario newspaper reported Wednesday.
Companies linked to Coca Cola bought a 7 percent stake in Andina last year for $140 million, with the funds used to finance the firm's expansion abroad.
A statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission said Coca Cola was in talks to buy 18 million shares at $5.45 each, according to the newspaper.
Andina declined to comment on the report.
Andina is Chile's largest Coca Cola bottler and owns plants in Argentina and Brazil.
